assessment: This work is relevant to all who are interested in genome editing. The versatile Cas9 nuclease has enabled creative genome editing applications, yet the targetable sequence space is limited by the PAM specificity of the Cas9 RNP. This manuscript expands the Cas9 toolbox by defining the PAM specificity and genome editing activity of a large group of smaller-sized type II-C Cas9s. The results also contribute to our understanding of the diversity of Cas enzymes and show that there is a significant potential in mining for non-trivial genome editing tools amongst highly similar Cas orthologs.
